role: bounded serialization and integrity analysis; not an implemented transport or scientific campaign

design.acceptance: issue each content-bound signed receipt promptly after reserving its acceptance frames and the incremental worst-case terminal-batch growth
design.terminal: one same-origin payload containing individually signed terminal witnesses and one shared signed checkpoint
design.reservation: reserve acceptance frames plus max(0, envelope_frames(k+1)-envelope_frames(k)) before each new promise; the first member also reserves envelope_frames(1)
design.flush: flush before the earliest receipt inclusion deadline and before waiting would make any member stale for allocation

required_checks: every receipt verifies against its original content and the shared checkpoint
record reorder fails the ordered receipt/content association
aggregate reservation is never below serialized terminal frames
one-record behavior is no worse than the current serializer
scope_limits: Same-origin serialization analysis only. No cross-origin aggregation, availability, BFT, finality, censorship-resistance, throughput-recovery, or scientific claim.
